text: Seems like Hals mission went from elevating the consciousness of gumanity to earning a lot of good money from people with the free 7-day-free-trial-trap. What happened to the free version? Could you at least be honest about deactivating it with the 'upgrade'?
author: Thorbjørn Jensen
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback. Our mission remains committed to elevating consciousness. While we've introduced premium features to sustain the app's development, we still offer several free features. We apologize for any confusion with the upgrade and appreciate your understanding.
